text: Delivered in merge db0c12a (branch commits aad64cc, 0fb0cde, merge 948dd09); main's tree equals the verified branch tree 0a4d750. Fresh-process reconstruction: separate writer and reader JVMs (distinct pids asserted) over the io test classpath; fixation, recording and temporal studies saved through manifests, resolved via ArtifactFiles, re-executed and compared by canonical SHA-256 and raw IEEE bits; refusals asserted by innermost typed cause (flipped byte -> Digest; unregistered codec -> MissingResultCodec; consistently re-declared packed double -> InputIdentity, then RecordingOf, then the unchanged plan's ArtifactMismatch; dropped exclusion -> QuarantineScope). Pinned as known limits: consistent forgeries that also rewrite the plan's input digest, and dropped standalone rejections, resolve; documented under 'What verification establishes'. Schema-compatibility policy in DOMAIN_CODECS.md enforced over all 16 shipped document schemas plus packed-recording@1 (unknown versions refused by name, 0/-1/1.5 invalid, unknown members ignored but cannot pass digest checks, unknown enum values refused at a located path). SchemaRegistryJvmSuite requires a law and a pinned fixture for each of the 22 built-in identities, with sensitivity checks; new PayloadLaws, ArtifactCodecLawSuite, PlanCodecLawSuite without suchThat. New fixtures: manifest-inputs-v1, recording-standalone-v1, binocular-recording-v1, packed-recording-v1 with 4 payloads, temporal-base-v1, temporal-study-v1, timeline-v1, score-codecs-v1. Fresh-context review: merge after fixes (one blocker), all applied. Verified: root 3,341 on the merged tree, consumer 23/23 both runtimes.
